new_types.name: publication_statement
new_types.description: A title-page statement identifying the printer or publisher, place or date of publication, price, or publication rights, distinct from the book title and its credits.
new_types.evidence: Page 7 gives the publisher, Bombay, 1903 and the price; page 9 gives corresponding publication details and a rights statement.

new_types.name: title_page_credit
new_types.description: A title-page statement naming the author, editor or other contributor, including associated qualifications or affiliations, distinct from the title and publication statement.
new_types.evidence: Page 7 names Kshemendra and the editors under 'EDITED BY'; page 9 gives corresponding Sanskrit credits.

new_types.name: section_end_marker
new_types.description: A brief concluding label marking the end of a named episode or subdivision, rather than a heading introducing what follows.
new_types.evidence: The numbered line 'इत्यतिकायवधः ॥ ३२ ॥' follows verse १५० and precedes verse १५१.

questions: On PDF page 380, should the numbered episode-ending label be treated as the conclusion of a section, or as a heading for the following text?
